kyoto_sushi_taka_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and side dishes — uzaku, ankimo, squid tempura, chawanmushi, red miso soup; soy sauce and tsume not described (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_taka_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 16:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 on a raised tatami platform (Tabelog). Off Yamato-oji south of Shijo in Gion, near Keihan Gion-Shijo; moved here in August 2010 after earlier sites in Gion and on Teramachi (Tabelog). Real wasabi (June 2025).
kyoto_sushi_taka_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion off Yamato-oji, a warm neighbourhood counter] A small, homely sushi counter off Yamato-oji where regulars drink over crab, uni, ankimo and chawanmushi and finish with nigiri and red miso soup — heartfelt rather than refined, at about ¥10,000 with drinks. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a warm, friendly atmosphere made by the chef and the owner (December 2024) and count it among the few small, reasonably priced sushi counters in Gion run by couples (June 2025). Tabelog notes moves from 祇園町北側 (2010) and Teramachi-Takoyakushi (2007).

anecdotes.text: A couple come every year at the end of December; in 2025 it was packed and lively.
A June 2025 guest, a fan of individually run places, found the anago melted in the mouth.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨嵩、寿司、東山区大和大路四条下る大和町21-1、祇園四条駅から145m、月〜土 16:00〜21:30、日曜定休、現金のみ、16席 (カウンター8、小上がり8)、2010年8月に祇園町北側282-5から、2007年7月に寺町蛸薬師から移転。口コミ (2024〜2025年、英語): 蟹と塩うにの先付、本わさび、赤だし、とろける穴子、うざく、あん肝、いかの天ぷら、茶碗蒸し、まぐろ、鯛、ぶり、うなぎ、サーモン、うに、玉子の握り、飲んで1万円ほど、料理人と店主の温かい雰囲気、夫婦で営む小さな店のひとつ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; cash only.

kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. A5 Wagyu yakiniku with a house sauce described as additive-free, plus yukhoe, namul, kimchi and salads; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu yakiniku restaurant; namul and kimchi are sides (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30; dinner 17:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; 2026). Cards including UnionPay, IC cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 36 seats: 10 at the counter, 16 at tables; room for strollers between tables (Tabelog; October 2026). On the ground floor of the UGK Building in an alley between Kawaramachi and Kiyamachi, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi or Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; 2026).
kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi alley, A5 Wagyu until 3:00] A calm, modern yakiniku room in a quiet alley off Kiyamachi serving hand-cut A5 Wagyu — yukhoe, thick tongue, yaki-shabu, harami — with namul and kimchi, at lunch and until 3:00. Sister of BISTRO MAUMU and the Gion Yakiniku Maumu. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T6130001067887 is registered to 株式会社ＧＭＩ (NTA register), the operator also recorded for BISTRO MAUMU in our data, which runs 焼肉マウム in Gion and 居酒屋 マウム. Tabelog’s shop text describes female-cattle A5 Wagyu hand-cut by skilled staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Additive-free house sauce to bring out the meat (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular of the Gion branch tried this one with friends as the first stop of a night out.
An October 2026 family found space between tables for a stroller and let the staff season the meat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉 マウム 京都木屋町店、焼肉・ホルモン、中京区北車屋町265-1 UGKビル1F、阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:30)、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、36席 (カウンター10、テーブル16)、雌牛のA5黒毛和牛を職人が手切り、無添加の自家製だれ、適格請求書 T6130001067887 (株式会社ＧＭＩ)。口コミ (2026年、英語): ナムル盛り800円、キムチ3種800円、チョレギサラダ800円、和牛ユッケ1,600円、上タン2,300円、ブリスケの焼きしゃぶ1,500円、ヒレ塩1,400円、カルビたれ1,680円、ハラミ、上カルビ、ミノ、ホソ、チャミスル1,320円、祇園店もある。

kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese dishes — sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, tempura, suppon courses with fried suppon and hot pot; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, duck and soft-shell turtle dishes (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 18:00–5:00 (L.O. 4:00); days off not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original お通し代 お一人様550円). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 39 seats, all on tatami with sunken kotatsu (Tabelog; June 2025). On the 2nd floor up a steep stair, on Kiyamachi south of Sanjo; the toilet is outside (August and November 2025). About 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.notes: [Japanese izakaya · Kiyamachi 2F, fish and suppon until 5:00] A tatami-floored izakaya up a steep stair on Kiyamachi, where a chef with French training cooks seasonal fish, tempura, kappo dishes and year-round soft-shell turtle courses, with plenty of sake and free-flow plans. ¥550 otoshi; open until 5:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the owner-chef has experience in French cooking and adds original dishes to Kyoto and other Japanese food. Tabelog’s invoice number T4130001063137 is registered to 株式会社いさむ at the shop’s address (NTA register). A February 2026 reviewer mentions a one-person operation that night.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 first-timer at soft-shell turtle got through the fried suppon but left half the porridge, too full to finish.
An August 2026 pair chose it for fish on a second stop and booked a 90-minute free-flow plan with a coupon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒肴いさ味、居酒屋・海鮮・すっぽん、中京区河原町通三条下る二丁目北車屋町265-1、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、18:00〜翌5:00 (L.O.4:00)、不定休、お通し代1人550円、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、39席、全席座敷 (掘りごたつ)、割烹料理と創作和食、旬の魚、天ぷら、通年のすっぽん料理、フレンチ出身の店主、適格請求書 T4130001063137 (株式会社いさむ)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): すっぽんのコース (前菜、刺身、煮物、唐揚げ、鍋、雑炊)、湯葉の先付・刺身・煮物・焼き魚・天ぷら・味噌汁・おにぎりのコースと飲み放題で約6,000円、90分飲み放題5,500円、鉄板焼き、鴨、カツ、寒ぶり、日本酒が豊富、急な階段、トイレは外。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off, tatami seating; steep stairs; ¥550 otoshi.

kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yellow Chinese wheat noodles in a niku-soba-style broth, with tenkasu (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat-topped noodles in a meat-and-dashi broth (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:30) daily; until 5:00 on the eve of holidays (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter seats only (June 2026). Self-service tenkasu, plain and spicy (June and December 2025). In Kiyamachi near Sanjo, about 280 m from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog). Opened 18 May 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.notes: [Noodle bar · Kiyamachi, after-drinks niku soba] A small counter in Kiyamachi for the end of a night out, serving bowls of thin-sliced meat over yellow noodles in a light, golden broth (¥1,200), with spicy tenkasu to add yourself, curry soba and mazesoba. Cash only; open until 3:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a niku-soba-like dish made with Chinese noodles, with tenkasu at the counter to add yourself — more like a soba or udon shop than a ramen shop (December 2025) — and a regular’s favourite after drinks (March and May 2026).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular, on a fifth visit after drinks, got to try the new mazesoba before its April launch.
A June 2026 visitor was sent here for a late bowl by a local obanzai restaurant.

kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: parfaits with cookies and sponge cake, pancake sandwiches and cheesecake (2020–2025 reviews); ask about rice balls and amazake.
kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.vegan_detail: Ask: amazake and plum shaved ice may suit, but parfaits use cream and ice cream, and no source says what goes into the sake-lees soup (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.hours_raw: Tabelog: Fri–Sun 11:30–19:30 (food last order 18:30, drinks 19:00); closed Monday to Thursday. The operator's page gives weekdays 11:30–18:00 and weekends and holidays 10:30–18:00 — check before going. Reservations taken; about 9–10 seats (one table for four and a short counter), so groups may be turned away (August 2024). Pay first; cash, cards, transit IC, PayPay and other QR. Take-away sweets. Non-smoking; children welcome. Ground floor of a small hotel on Yamatooji below Shijo (Tabelog: ホテルRinn; operator: ホテル鈴). Opened here 2 October 2020 (Tabelog) after a move (November 2020 review).
kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.notes: [Café & sake bar · Yamatooji near Kenninji, deer parfaits and sake-lees soup] A tiny wood-toned café on the ground floor of a Gion hotel, run by a Kyoto kaiseki company: deer-cookie matcha parfaits, summer shaved ice, sake-lees soup with miso rice balls, and sake by the glass. One person often makes everything, so expect a wait. Open Friday–Sunday per Tabelog — check hours.

chef_bio.background: Run by Tatsuuma Corporation (辰馬コーポレーション), which also runs the Kyoto kaiseki house せんしょう in Ukyo and, since June 2025, おづ おむすびカフェ at Bivi Nijo (operator site). Reviewers tie the café to a Nishinomiya sake brewery through the president's family and note sweets made with its daiginjo (2023–2025). It moved to this hotel ground floor in 2020 (November 2020 review). An August 2024 reviewer warns that "one staff member prepares everything in sequence, which does result in a wait time".

anecdotes.text: January 2021: "The parfait came with a deer-shaped cookie! It's adorable, but the cookie is quite large (laughs)."
August 2024: "During our stay, two groups were turned away due to being full."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 運営会社のサイト: 祇園おづ［cafe & SAKE Bar］、京都市東山区大和大路通四条下ル3博多町67 ホテル鈴1F、月〜金 11:30〜18:00、土日祝 10:30〜18:00、パフェやチーズケーキと日本酒・和惣菜、テイクアウト。辰馬コーポレーションは京料理・京会席 せんしょう、祇園おづを運営し、2025年6月20日に Bivi二条に「おづ おむすびカフェ」をオープン。食べログ: おづkyoto‐maison du sake plus Cafe‐、日本料理・カフェ・日本酒バー、東山区博多町67 ホテルRinn 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、金〜日 11:30〜19:30 (料理 L.O. 18:30、ドリンク L.O. 19:00)、月〜木休み、予約可、10席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・QR可、2020年10月2日オープン、姉妹店の料理人によるふかひれ丼と粕汁。口コミ (2020年11月〜2026年4月、英語): 移転してホテルの1階へ、鹿のクッキーのパフェ (祇園抹茶894円、桃990円)、抹茶白玉かき氷990円、梅のかき氷、チョコパフェ1,000円、甘酒りんごパフェ、甘酒、パンケーキサンド、大吟醸のチーズケーキ、酒粕汁と味噌おむすび、日本酒、先払い、ひとりで順に作るので待つ (2024年8月)。

kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.gf_detail: Ask: a whisky and cocktail bar with no food described; check beer and liqueurs (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.vegan_detail: Ask: drinks only in the sources; some cocktails use cream, egg or honey (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 14:00–24:00; closing days not fixed. Call ahead for space (May 2026). Smoking allowed. Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners per Tabelog). A Y- or L-shaped counter and one sofa table for four (July 2022; July 2024). 2nd floor of 伽羅ビル on Gokomachi below Rokkaku. Open since about 2014 ("four years" in November 2018).
kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.notes: [Whisky & cocktail bar · Gokomachi near Rokkaku, open from 2 pm] A moody second-floor bar with a long counter and walls of bottles, pouring from 2 pm: the namesake Silent Third cocktail built on the whisky you like, sharp gin and tonics and rare bourbons. Some reviewers find the welcome cool at first. Smoking allowed. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say it opened around 2014 and comes from the Bar K6 line (November 2018; July 2022); one in July 2022 thought it "appears to be run by a single person", with paintings by the same hand on the walls, while a July 2024 group met the owner and female staff. Reviews praise skill and knowledge; criticism: "the service to be somewhat off-putting" (September 2022) and an atmosphere that is "just okay" (July 2022).

anecdotes.text: January 2019: "When I ordered at Silent Third, they asked me what base whisky I preferred, and I requested something peaty. It turned out to be Caol Ila."
July 2024: "The staff were wonderful; they looked a bit cold at first, but were very kind."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー サイレント サード、バー、中京区御幸町六角下ル伊勢屋町354-1 伽羅ビル 2F、毎日 14:00〜24:00、不定休、喫煙可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2016年11月〜2026年5月、英語): 昼2時から飲めるバー、店名のカクテル「サイレントサード」は好みのウイスキーで (グレンモーレンジィ、カリラ)、スター・オブ・ボンベイのジントニック、度数の高いバーボンのハイボール、余市、オリジナルラベルのスペイサイド、シンガポールスリング、マティーニ、コスモポリタン、K6 の系譜、2014年ごろ開店、ひとりで営むように見える (2022年7月)、接客が合わないという声 (2022年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Classic bar; smoking allowed.

kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.gf_detail: Ask: cocktails and spirits may suit; the food includes pasta, omurice and baguette (official site; 2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.vegan_detail: Ask: fresh-fruit cocktails and juices (2025–2026 reviews); the food includes cream pasta and omurice.
kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.hours_raw: Tabelog and official site: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00; closed Monday. Reservations taken; group bookings 21:00–23:00 by arrangement; private hire for 12–30 by phone. Table charge ¥500 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「500円」. 29 seats: counter, sofas and an open terrace (smoking on the terrace only). Pets welcome; English menu; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi. Cards and e-money (Edy, QUICPay); no QR. Ground floor of a small hotel (MYK HOUSE, March 2018) on a back street west of the Kamo River near Shimizucho. Opened 23 February 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.notes: [Cocktail bar · back street by the Kamo below Shijo, terrace and a Hokkaido master] A roomy bar with sofas and an open terrace on the ground floor of a small hotel, run by a friendly master from Hokkaido: cocktails made to your taste, fresh-fruit drinks, good whisky and, on request, pasta. ¥500 charge. Smoking on the terrace only; pets welcome. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2018 (Tabelog) on the ground floor of a hotel guests often use for long stays (July 2020). Reviewers describe the master as "from Hokkaido" (July 2020) and "friendly and engaging" (December 2025), with other staff who explain the drinks in detail (April 2024). Pasta was dropped from the menu, "possibly due to staffing issues", but was made on request in December 2025.

anecdotes.text: July 2020: "The master was so cool while shaking the cocktails that I went home the next day and bought a cocktail shaker myself!"
December 2025: "My wife, who doesn't drink alcohol, always requests fresh juice made from fruits."

kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.gf_detail: Ask: salt-grilled skewers may suit, but the secret tare, meat miso, ramen and curry do not (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori counter; vegetable skewers exist, but nothing is described as vegan (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: from 18:00 until sold out; closed Sundays and public holidays; hours may change. Reservations strongly advised — 10 counter seats, often full (2024–2026 reviews). Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners per Tabelog); no e-money or QR. Ground floor of ユニバース会館 on Tominaga-cho east of Nawate, south side.
kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.notes: [Yakitori · Gion Tominaga-cho, binchotan-grilled Kyoto akajidori] A snug 10-seat counter off Nawate where Kyoto akajidori goes over binchotan: rare breast, smoky tsukune, soft quail eggs and good vegetable skewers, with egg-over-rice or curry to finish. Prices are clear for Gion — about ¥10,000 for a big meal with drinks (March 2026). Book ahead. Closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 call it a hidden gem and a favourite, praising precise grilling, the freedom to order skewer by skewer, and clear pricing; one March 2026 diner paid ¥10,164 for 11 skewers, sides, a rice finish and several shochu sodas. The September 2026 reviewer took the omakase, "allowing the chef to serve me his recommendations".

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "Even in Gion, this place offers clear pricing and is a great restaurant."
January 2025: "The grilled tsukune may look burnt, but it wasn't bitter at all and was delicious!"

Kept in Kyoto by a double typhoon in June 2026, a family with three small children called ahead and found the second-floor tatami room otherwise empty; the children loved the duck breast.
A solo June 2026 diner marked summer with hamo sashimi and Kamo eggplant agedashi over a draft beer.

kyoto_silk_pound_cake.notes: [Pound cake · Gokomachi] A takeaway pound-cake specialist near Nishiki Market with an arched door: glazed Lemon Sweet, mini cakes of pistachio-cherry or blueberry-cheese around ¥500, and seasonal sakura or apple, in pretty Kyoto gift bags. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.philosophy: Pound cakes pursuing a smooth, rich sweetness, for a luxurious moment (official site).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 visitor thought the shopfront looked like a nail salon, then chose blueberry, pistachio and lemon mini cakes from more than ten kinds.
An April 2026 buyer of three cakes, including a spring Sakura Pound, was taken with the Kyoto-styled shopping bag.
A January 2025 reviewer found the Lemon Sweet's glaze stronger than its lemon.

kyoto_ryuan_gion_shijo.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Gion-Shijo] A calm yakiniku of private and semi-private rooms by the Kamo River at Gion-Shijo: good-value yaki-shabu lunches around ¥1,600 and, at night, Kobe and Omi wagyu — tongue in several cuts, chateaubriand, stone-pot liver — from about ¥10,000. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A Gion-Shijo yakiniku restaurant (official site; Tabelog) whose menu opens by promising "the best meat of your life" (October 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: Starting a meat trip in January 2026, a diner had the Kobe and Omi special set and added a thick Omi chateaubriand for ¥3,000.
A January 2026 lunch guest caught one of the five daily raw hamburg steaks, tender enough to eat with a spoon.
An October 2026 diner called the ¥25,000 course not expensive, from Kobe beef carpaccio to three cuts of tongue.

kyoto_yumeya_kiyamachi_late.notes: [Izakaya · Nishi-Kiyamachi, midnight to 8 a.m.] A long-running izakaya that only opens at midnight, the last stop after Kiyamachi's bars: fresh daily sashimi, fried horse mackerel, simmered shellfish, tempura and dashimaki, finishing with kitsune udon or a rice bowl. Counter only. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a long-established counter izakaya on Nishi-Kiyamachi open from midnight until 8 a.m., a regular last stop for people coming off a night out (2018–2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2018 group, flagging at 4 a.m., shared kitsune udon, hoya with ponzu and grilled thick tofu — the tofu a little underdone.
A July 2022 regular who comes after drinking calls the fried horse mackerel exceptional and the sashimi always fresh.
A June 2026 visitor on the last night of a trip found it more of a proper izakaya than expected, with a ¥900 conger and negi tempura.

kyoto_sashimi_no_gyoshin.notes: [Fish izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, sashimi] A quiet, tucked-away izakaya true to its name: a platter of eight kinds of sashimi, two pieces each, then the head of the day's fish grilled or braised as you like, kinmedai, guji and ankimo, with sake. A May 2026 reviewer saw a sign saying only Japanese speakers are served. One found the simmered fish bony, another the sake list short. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seafood izakaya of 25 seats east of the BAL building. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe very fresh sashimi, fish heads of the day prepared to order, reasonable prices and a quiet room with few tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; fish head of the day.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor saw a sign at the entrance saying the shop only accommodates those who can communicate in Japanese.
A May 2026 business group found the braised kijihata head the highlight — the speciality is the day's fish head done as you like.
A May 2025 pair loved the sashimi but found the simmered fish bony and hard to eat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮・居酒屋、中京区河原町通三条下ル四筋目BALビル東入ル山崎町246-102 クラリオンビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、火〜日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、月曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、25席、カウンター、禁煙。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年5月、英語): 雑居ビル1階の奥、静かで観光客が少ない、8種2切れずつの刺身の盛り合わせ (さんま、地元の白身など)、その日の魚のかしらを好みの調理で (鯛のかぶと焼き、きじはたの煮付け)、きんめだいの煮付け、ぐじの焼き物、あん肝、さざえの煮物、わかさぎの唐揚げ、天ぷら、日本酒、サワー、クラフトビール、入口に「日本語でコミュニケーションできる方のみ」の張り紙があったとの声 (2026年5月)、煮魚は骨が多いとの声 (2025年5月)、日本酒の種類が少ないとの声 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese speakers only, per an entrance sign seen in May 2026; counter; cards.

kyoto_babele_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Daily obanzai and ethnic small plates — yum woon sen, simmered and fried vegetables — but also pasta, yakisoba and fries; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_babele_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Several vegetable obanzai (eggplant in broth, red konnyaku, Jerusalem artichoke salad), but dashi, egg and fish are common; no ingredient information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_babele_gion.hours_raw: Wednesday–Friday 18:00–2:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 15:00–24:00; closed Monday and Tuesday, and Sunday and Monday in the last week of the month; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog). A large shared table; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Tabelog notes the menu has moved from Italian to obanzai and ethnic dishes. 1F of the Gion Nawate White building, down a narrow alley north of Shijo off Yamato-oji; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2025).
kyoto_babele_gion.notes: [Obanzai bar · Gion, off Nawate] A warm little bar at the end of a narrow alley near Shinbashi, where the owner cooks a changing spread of gently seasoned obanzai and ethnic plates — eggplant in broth, yam pouches, yum woon sen, squid shiokara with butter cabbage — plus pasta and yakisoba, with wine or sake at a big shared table. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a wine bar first listed as Italian that has moved to obanzai and ethnic dishes. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe hand-made dishes by the woman who runs it, subtle seasoning, warm conversation and a homely feel.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 diner was struck by obanzai seasoned far more gently than at tourist-facing places, and by yum woon sen with adjustable heat.
A November 2024 fan tried to recreate the squid shiokara with cabbage and butter at home and could not match it.
An October 2026 regular orders the Jerusalem artichoke salad whenever it appears.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー、東山区大和大路通四条上ル三丁目弁財天町13 祇園縄手ホワイトビル 1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、水〜金 18:00〜翌2:00、土日祝 15:00〜24:00、月・火曜休み (月末の週は日・月曜休み)、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード可、禁煙、20名まで貸切可、業態が変わり今はイタリアンよりおばんざいとエスニック料理。口コミ (2020年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 細い路地の奥、店主の女性の手作り、日替わりのおばんざい、山芋と卵白の袋煮に卵黄、赤こんにゃくの煮物、なすの揚げびたし、辛さを選べるヤムウンセン、いかの塩辛とキャベツのバター炒め、胡椒のポテトサラダ、鯖などの日替わりパスタ、焼きそば、菊芋のサラダ、フライドポテト、大きなテーブル、日本酒、ワイン。

kyoto_201_gion_wagyu_wine_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu steak, roast beef sushi, prosciutto and cheese (2022–2026 reviews).

kyoto_201_gion_wagyu_wine_bar.notes: [Wine bar · Gion Yasaka-shinchi, till 1 a.m.] A hidden second-floor bar in Gion where a sommelier owner pours wine, Champagne and whisky alongside proper food: steak of the day, roast beef temari sushi, carbonara and Spanish ham with persimmon — for a full course or a late second stop, with a private room for birthdays. ¥500 charge; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining and wine bar opened 11 July 2019 in Gion, with wines, Champagne and whisky chosen by the owner-sommelier. A December 2021 reviewer knew it as Dining bar MO-JI; a November 2024 reviewer refers to the owner as the mama.
chef_bio.philosophy: Proper food until late, with the owner's chosen wines (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Steak of the day; roast beef temari sushi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2022 birthday pair took a private room on a course of about ¥5,000, added pasta and cheese, and found sparkling wine only by the half bottle — about ¥24,000 for two with a surprise plate.
An August 2026 regular who usually comes just to drink had the steak of the day — lean, high-quality red meat.
A December 2021 guest, taken there by a friend, had walked past the narrow entrance many times without noticing it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・ワインバー・イタリアン、東山区八坂新地末吉町99-3 ランスロットビル 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 18:00〜翌1:00、日・月曜休み、予約可、チャージ料500円、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、14席、4名までの個室、全席喫煙可、2019年7月11日開店、ソムリエの店主が選ぶワイン・シャンパン・ウイスキー。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 以前は Dining bar MO-JI との声、入口が狭く見落としやすい、本日のステーキ、ローストビーフの手毬寿司、カルボナーラなどのパスタ、ピザ、スペインの生ハムと柿のバルサミコ、チーズの盛り合わせ、5,000円ほどのコース、スパークリングはハーフボトルのみ6,000円ほど (2022年10月)、誕生日のプレート。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden upstairs bar; ¥500 charge; smoking allowed; cards.

kyoto_sushi_hayashi.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of sushi and seasonal appetisers; the rice is said to be made without sugar and the soup is a clear bonito broth, but no gluten information is published (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_sushi_hayashi.hours_raw: Reservation only. Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30) Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday; dinner 18:00–21:00 (last entry 18:30) Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; closed Wednesday and Thursday, plus irregular days (Tabelog). Prices include tax and service; cancellation charge 100% on the day, 50% the two days before (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; no children; smart casual; non-smoking (Tabelog). Run by a couple (2021 reviews). 6 min walk from Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn, 12 min from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_hayashi.notes: [Sushi · north of the Imperial Palace, a couple's nine-seat omakase] A quiet, dimly lit nine-seat counter near Demachiyanagi run by a sushi master and wife: a pure, restrained omakase — sugar-free rice, barely seasoned gari, clear bonito soup — with nodoguro, anago and uni among the pieces, and sake or Swiss wine. Listed by Michelin six years running, per the shop. About ¥20,000–40,000; booking only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef, with the owner’s wife front of house (2021 reviews); names not given
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 May 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: listed in the Michelin Guide for six consecutive years; sushi and seasonal appetisers made with fresh ingredients sourced directly from the area; two omakase courses at lunch and one at dinner. Reviewers (2021) describe a friendly owner and the owner’s wife running it together.

anecdotes.text: A December 2021 first-timer, after years of wanting to come, found the hostess’s smiles soothing.
An October 2021 guest came for the Swiss wine and ordered the dinner course at lunch.
A May 2025 diner found the fatty tuna surprisingly light and the style "transparent", with nothing superfluous.

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; no children; smart casual.

kyoto_kitocafe.gf_detail: Ask. Cakes — shortcakes, tarte Tatin, cheesecake, gâteau chocolat — and lunch plates such as a fried hamburg, sandwiches and borscht; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kitocafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, hamburg and chicken plates (reviews).

Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: a small counter and tables, window seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; March 2025). Fills quickly on weekends, with queues (March 2025). Cakes to take away (Tabelog). Up the stairs on the 2nd floor off the Demachi shopping street, 1 min from the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_kitocafe.notes: [Café · Demachi, seasonal shortcakes upstairs] A calm second-floor café just off the Demachi shopping street, with a blackboard lunch — a Greek-style hamburg or chicken plate with soup and rice for about ¥1,100 — and beautiful seasonal cakes: towering strawberry or peach shortcake, tarte Tatin, cheesecake. Busy at weekends; cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 October 2010 (Tabelog). A March 2026 reviewer says it is run by one person; an October 2026 reviewer was welcomed by two women.

anecdotes.text: A three-time visitor (November 2024) came back for the Jonathan-apple tarte Tatin.
An August 2026 visitor finally made it after three or four years of meaning to, for the peach shortcake.
A March 2025 couple after cherry-blossom viewing were seated at once; a queue had formed by the time of leaving.

kyoto_green_farm_demachi.notes: [Soft serve · Demachiyanagi, a dairy's milk-and-smoothie stand] A small shop on Yanagi-dori run by a long-established dairy, pouring soft serve and a soft milk pudding made with Miyama milk, fruit smoothies and a milk tasting. kyoto_le_sucrier.hours_raw: 11:30–18:30 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday; Sunday café from 14:00; closed Tuesday and Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). kyoto_le_sucrier.notes: [Patisserie · Teramachi-Imadegawa, a 1990 neighbourhood cake shop] A slightly dim, antique-styled cake shop just north of Imadegawa, with a showcase of carefully made cakes and a small café behind: cream puffs, a chestnut-and-rum Mon Carré, spice caramel, cheesecake and pudding with a deep-roast coffee. Many take cakes to the Kamo delta. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Friday.

chef_bio.background: Per a September 2024 reviewer, established in 1990 and loved by locals. Reviewers (2021–2026) describe an antique-feeling shop with a cake case at the front and a café at the back.

anecdotes.text: A May 2022 visitor took cream puffs to the Kamo delta, remembering a hawk that once snatched a snack there.
An August 2025 guest smelled eggs and butter on entering and paired a cream puff and pudding with iced coffee.
A March 2026 regular struggled to put into words how good the chestnut Mon Carré was.

kyoto_kyomachi_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based Kyoto courses with eel, ayu and beef sukiyaki (2023–25 reviews).
kyoto_kyomachi_pontocho.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday (some Sundays) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins have been seated if ordering a course (Tabelog; June 2011). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). Private tatami rooms for 2–6, some looking over the Kamo river (Tabelog; March 2024). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). An old townhouse on Pontocho north of Shijo (Tabelog; 2010–25 reviews).
kyoto_kyomachi_pontocho.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, an old townhouse on the river] A long-standing Pontocho townhouse with private tatami rooms, some looking over the Kamo river, serving delicate Kyoto courses — eel-themed in summer, with grilled ayu and ginger rice — and sukiyaki, at fair prices for Pontocho. A guest of 40 years (2014 review) recalls koto music playing throughout. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant in a townhouse on Pontocho. An August 2014 review comes from a guest of 40 years; a December 2022 review describes an attentive owner, decorative roofs, punched walls and an antique telephone.

anecdotes.text: An August 2014 guest of 40 years remembered the koto playing throughout the house.
A June 2025 diner had an eel-themed course by the river, from Arima-yaki to vinegared eel and cucumber.
A December 2022 visitor came for the steamed turnip on the menu and praised the ring of sake poured from the tokkuri.

kyoto_sanju_gosai_tenshin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai with fish, beef tendon, duck and beef hot pots (2022–25 reviews).
kyoto_sanju_gosai_tenshin.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). kyoto_sanju_gosai_tenshin.notes: [Obanzai and hot pots · Pontocho, open from 4 pm] A relaxed Pontocho izakaya serving trios of obanzai with a one-person hot pot — duck, beef, hamo or anko — plus yuba, braised beef tendon and Kyoto sake, from mid-afternoon. Casual by Pontocho standards; service can be slow at busy times.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant opened in April 2011 serving healthy dishes of fresh vegetables, chosen seafood and meat, blending Japanese, Western, Chinese and Korean styles.
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy, nutritious dishes from fresh vegetables, fish and meat (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2022 visitor who missed out on riverside dining found a set of three obanzai with hamo and duck hot pots for ¥1,780.
A December 2025 diner was invited in from the street and had a anko hot pot with three sakes.
A November 2023 group waited over 15 minutes for menus and never received the shabu-shabu ladle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区先斗町四条上ル下樵木町200-3、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日16:00〜23:00、予約可、カード可、35席、カウンター、貸切20〜50名、分煙、2011年4月8日オープン、新鮮な野菜と魚介と肉の和洋中韓の健康的な料理。口コミ (2022年4月〜2025年12月、英語): おばんざい3品と選べる鍋 (鴨、牛、鱧) にご飯と香の物で約1,780〜1,800円、湯葉、牛すじの煮込み、anko の鍋、すき焼き、しゃぶしゃぶ、日本酒、混むと提供が遅い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order an obanzai trio with a hot pot; open from mid-afternoon. No English evidence found.

Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 155 seats, with semi-private rooms; shares the floor with the crab-buffet restaurant Kani Gin (Tabelog; October 2025; February and April 2026). Order by QR code, with the remaining time shown (February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No sign at street level — take the lift to 5F of Kawaramachi DECK by COAST, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 1 August 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tori_sakana_kawaramachi.notes: [All-you-can-eat izakaya · Kawaramachi, yakitori, sushi and hot pots] A 155-seat izakaya on the fifth floor of a Kawaramachi building, sharing the floor with the crab buffet Kani Gin: all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from about ¥3,000 with yakitori by the skewer, sushi by the piece and chanko, motsu or chicken hot pots, ordered by QR code. Mixed reviews on how freshly the food is made.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an all-you-can-eat izakaya opened in August 2024, with sister shops in Nagoya Kanayama, Umeda and Kobe Sannomiya; the official site belongs to 株式会社WILL, which also runs Kani Gin (on the same floor and already listed).
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat yakitori, sushi and hot pots.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor liked that the QR menu shows the time left on the all-you-can-eat plan.
A March 2025 diner found the dishes reheated and the salt yakitori cold.
An April 2026 visitor recommends the chicken hot pot on the ¥3,500 course.

kyoto_teppan_futagoya_tominokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef tongue, wagyu offal, shrimp mayo, dashimaki (2026 reviews).

Reservations accepted; seat type cannot be guaranteed (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 34 seats incl. a counter and sofas (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only inside; ashtrays outside for cigarettes (Tabelog). Appetizer ¥350 (April 2026). Medina Shijo Tominokoji 1F, 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi exit 12 (Tabelog). Opened 27 August 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_futagoya_tominokoji.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Shijo Tominokoji, dashimaki your way] A friendly 34-seat teppan izakaya a minute from Kawaramachi exit 12, known for a build-your-own teppan dashimaki, thick salted beef tongue and wagyu offal, with a weekend afternoon happy hour from ¥298, all-you-can-drink even for one, and a dice game for drinks. ¥350 appetizer.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppan izakaya, "an adult tavern of seasonal ingredients, teppan and sake", opened in August 2022; a sister shop, 農家野菜 フタゴヤ, is in Pontocho. A September 2026 regular reports a recent renovation and a new menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients and dishes that go with drinks (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular on an eighth visit was offered free snacks while new dishes took time, after a renovation.
An August 2026 solo diner found a message written on the oshibori.
A September 2026 former regular found the menu halved and prices higher, and the kamameshi soggy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区富小路通錦小路下る西大文字町615番地 メディナ四条富小路 1F、阪急河原町駅12番出口から徒歩1分、月〜金17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、土日祝12:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、予約可、カード可、電子マネー不可、34席、加熱式たばこのみ可、2022年8月27日オープン、旬の食材と鉄板と酒の大人の酒場、具を選べる鉄板のだし巻き。口コミ (2026年1月〜9月、英語): 厚切りのねぎ塩牛タン1,100円、和牛ホルモン980円、だし巻き880円、エビマヨ600円、肉厚しいたけのかつおポン酢520円、お通し350円、とうもろこしの唐揚げ、チーズの鉄板餃子、鮭のカツ、里芋の揚げ物、焼売、春巻、土日の昼のハッピーアワー298円から、一人でも飲み放題、chinchiro、改装後メニューが減り値上がりとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Try the build-your-own dashimaki; heated tobacco only inside. No English evidence found.

kyoto_il_buco_pontocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, garlic baguette and arancini in the courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_il_buco_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, roast beef, duck and Bolognese in the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_il_buco_pontocho.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); lunch suspended for now; open all year. Reservations taken. Charge ¥300 a person — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お一人様につき300円」; riverside seats on the summer deck (kawayuka) cost ¥1,000 a person more (September 2026). 90 seats: sofas, a terrace over the Kamo River and a second floor used in rain. Non-smoking. English menu; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi. Cards, e-money and PayPay. Pontocho south of Sanjo. Formerly みます屋 イタリアーノ (Tabelog); its listed website is on the same domain as The みます屋 in Pontocho.
kyoto_il_buco_pontocho.notes: [Italian · Pontocho on the Kamo River, a riverside deck at fair prices] A big, friendly Italian on Pontocho with a summer deck over the river and a covered upstairs for rain: course menus with free-flow drinks, pasta, roast beef and duck. Reviewers call it good value for the location; some found pasta salty or courses served out of order. ¥300 charge, plus ¥1,000 for deck seats. Dinner only, daily.

chef_bio.background: Formerly みます屋 イタリアーノ (Tabelog), it shares its listed web domain (the-la-mart.com) with The みます屋 in Pontocho, which is already in data. Reviewers in 2025–2026 praise attentive staff and value; criticism covers slow service at Christmas (December 2025), slightly salty spaghetti (February 2026) and a main course served before the pasta "due to kitchen constraints" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian courses on the riverside deck.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "we encountered a sudden thunderstorm during our meal, but the staff promptly assisted us in moving to a second-floor seating area… they even remade the dishes we had already started eating."
October 2026: "I appreciated that the prices were not inflated like many tourist spots."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL BUCO (旧店名 みます屋 イタリアーノ)、イタリアン・日本料理・創作料理、中京区若松町140-2、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、ランチは当面休み、無休、予約可、原文で「お一人様につき300円」、90席、ソファ、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、法人会員。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 鴨川の納涼床、飲み放題付きのコース、前菜5種、ガーリックバゲット、生ハムのサラダ、アランチーニ、ローストビーフ、ボロネーゼ、マンゴープリン、鴨、ワイン、床席は追加で1人1,000円 (2026年9月)、雨の日は2階へ、パスタが少し塩辛い (2026年2月)、料理の順番違い (2026年7月)、提供が遅い (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; summer riverside deck.

kyoto_ufo_ice_cream_bar_gokomachi.gf_detail: Ask: some ice creams contain meringue, cookie or cheesecake pieces; one reviewer saw allergy notes (March 2026).
kyoto_ufo_ice_cream_bar_gokomachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk ice creams and cheesecake (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ufo_ice_cream_bar_gokomachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00; hours may change. Reservations advised — often full even on weekdays (March 2026; July 2026); one drink per person (July 2026). Table, counter and standing spots along the wall, plus a terrace (June 2026). Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay). 5th floor of 御幸町ビル on Gokomachi, between Shijo and Oike; no prominent sign (October 2026).
kyoto_ufo_ice_cream_bar_gokomachi.notes: [Ice-cream bar · Gokomachi, homemade scoops till 11 pm] A dim, stylish 5th-floor night café where young crowds book ahead for homemade ice cream in odd flavours — salt and olive oil, strawberry rosemary, Sichuan pepper and cream cheese — with wine, mead or a latte. One drink each. A June 2026 terrace guest found the service hard to flag down. Open daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from February to October 2026 describe a popular ice-cream and drinks bar, almost full by 20:30 even on weekdays, with a changing list of homemade ice creams and coffee made to order. Criticism: the ice cream is "a bit pricey" (July 2026), the oolong cheesecake "a bit dry" (March 2026), and on the windy terrace it was hard to call staff (June 2026).

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "Located on the top floor, there's a slight chance of being abducted by aliens, but it's the 5th floor."
June 2026: "The coffee is brewed fresh from the machine after you order, filling the elevator with a wonderful aroma."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: UFO、カフェ・バー、中京区伊勢屋町346 御幸町ビル 5F、京都河原町から404m、毎日 17:00〜23:00、時間は変わることがある、予約可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 夜のアイスクリームとお酒の店、自家製アイス660円、塩とオリーブオイルのバニラ、いちごとローズマリー、花椒とクリームチーズ、チャイチョコレート、キャラメルの焼きメレンゲ、黒糖バナナ、パイナップルライム、チョコレートとカルダモン、烏龍茶のバスクチーズケーキ、お祝いのプレート、コーヒー、ワイン、ミード、ワンドリンク制、予約がおすすめ、テラス席、アイスはやや高め。

kyoto_kiharu_yanaginobanba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura and fries in every course, homemade hishio (a soy-type sauce) for sashimi and soy-grilled dishes (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kiharu_yanaginobanba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Kyoto cooking with dashi throughout (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kiharu_yanaginobanba.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Sat, Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Wed and Fri dinner only; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken; a May 2026 reviewer says all seats are by reservation. 18 seats: 6 at the counter, 3 at a table downstairs and a private room upstairs for 4–8, one group a day. Non-smoking (smoking spot outside). Cards in the evening only; no e-money or QR. Down a long narrow passage off Yanaginobanba below Ayanokoji. Opened 22 May 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kiharu_yanaginobanba.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Yanaginobanba alley, small plates and homemade hishio] A tucked-away alley restaurant where a chatty counter serves a stream of tiny seasonal plates — hamo, Akashi squid, live-grilled ayu, rich homemade tofu — with house hishio for the sashimi, and good-value lunches with clay-pot rice. Booking needed; cards at night only. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 May 2018 (Tabelog). A September 2023 reviewer explains the name: one character from Kikuya in Miyagawa-cho, where the owner had worked, and the welcome "Kiharu" ("come in"). Reviewers since 2021 praise careful seasonal cooking, generous portions for the price and lively talk at the counter; one August 2026 diner found a tough piece in the fish tempura.

anecdotes.text: September 2022: "any leftovers could be made into onigiri (rice balls) to take home as a souvenir."
June 2024: "Salt-grilled sweetfish (we were shown live sweetfish before cooking!)."
April 2026: friends from Nara "jokingly said, 'Please guide us when we come again; we wouldn't be able to find it ourselves.'"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: きはる、日本料理、下京区柳馬場綾小路下る永原町147-2、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩6分、月・木・土・日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水・金は夜のみ、火曜休み、予約可、18席 (カウンター6、テーブル3、2階の個室8)、個室は1日1組、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カードは夜のみ、電子マネー・QR不可、2018年5月22日オープン、カウンターで豆皿料理、2階で会席や鍋のコース、法人会員。口コミ (2021年3月〜2026年9月、英語): 路地の奥の隠れ家、自家製のひしお、土鍋ご飯のおかわりと持ち帰りのおにぎり、昼3,400円 (2022年)・3,800円 (2024年)・弁当4,300円 (2026年5月)、鱧、明石のいか、目の前で見せる鮎の塩焼き、濃い自家製豆腐、鱧しゃぶ、鯛茶漬け、自家製アイス、日本酒のおまかせ、店名は宮川町の Kikuya から一字と「来はる」(2023年9月)、魚の天ぷらに硬い部分 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden alley; book ahead; cards at dinner only.

kyoto_bar_pleasure_aburayacho.gf_detail: Ask: cocktails and tequila may suit; the cover snacks are not described (Tabelog; 2016–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_pleasure_aburayacho.vegan_detail: Ask: cocktails, including non-alcoholic ones made to your taste (February 2025); snacks not described.
kyoto_bar_pleasure_aburayacho.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Thu 18:00–23:00; Fri 18:00–01:00; Sat 15:00–01:00; Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday). Reservations taken; private hire up to 20; event nights sometimes fill it (March 2019). Charge ¥300 with snacks; stays over an hour need another order — Tabelog, Japanese original 「チャージ料￥300（スナック付き） 1時間以上の滞在の場合、追加オーダーを頂戴します。」. 20 seats (12 counter, 8 table) and standing room. Smoking allowed. English menu; projector; free Wi-Fi. Cards; no e-money. 3rd floor of 洋燈館ビル. Opened 19 April 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_pleasure_aburayacho.notes: [B'z music bar · Aburaya-cho, songs, videos and cocktails by title] A third-floor bar for fans of the rock duo B'z — their music and concert videos all night, merchandise on the walls and cocktails named after their songs, mixed by a master who will also make anything (alcohol-free too) to your taste. ¥300 cover with snacks. Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 April 2012 (Tabelog). Reviewers since 2016 describe a "second hometown for B'z fans" (May 2017) where strangers bond over the band; the master holds a tequila certification (December 2023) and makes original cocktails, including non-alcoholic ones, from a described flavour or mood (February 2025). One February 2016 reviewer found the drinks heavy on ice for the price.

anecdotes.text: February 2025: "I left my drink choice to the master and opted for something refreshing… he can create original cocktails (including non-alcoholic options) based on the flavors I describe."
May 2017: "This place is like a second hometown for B'z fans! It's the perfect spot to quickly make friends with fellow fans inside the bar."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー プレジャー、バー・ワインバー・ダイニングバー、中京区油屋町145 洋燈館ビル 3F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、火〜木 18:00〜23:00、金 18:00〜翌1:00、土 15:00〜翌1:00、日祝 15:00〜23:00、月曜休み (祝日なら翌日)、予約可、貸切20名まで、原文で「チャージ料￥300（スナック付き） 1時間以上の滞在の場合、追加オーダーを頂戴します。」、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、立ち飲み、喫煙可、英語メニュー、プロジェクター、カード可、電子マネー不可、2012年4月19日オープン、法人会員。口コミ (2016年2月〜2025年11月、英語): B'z のバー、曲とライブ映像、グッズ、曲名のカクテル (800円から、サービス料10%と税、2016年)、HINOTORI カクテル、1杯目は定額で駄菓子付き (2019年)、テキーラの資格を持つマスター、好みで作るオリジナルカクテルとノンアルコール、氷が多いという声 (2016年)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; fan bar for B'z; smoking allowed.

kyoto_gion_obanzai_ginya.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, oden, saba sushi, tempura and sukiyaki, seasoned with soy and dashi; no gluten information (official site; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_obanzai_ginya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai with fish and meat dishes (official site; reviews).
kyoto_gion_obanzai_ginya.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). The shop’s own site gives 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30). Reservations essential — walk-ins not accepted (March 2025). Otoshi charged (Tabelog, original お通し代あり). Cards, IC cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and a tatami room for 4–6 (Tabelog). In Gion Shirakawa facing the Kamo River, 2 min from exit 9 of Gion-Shijo Station (Tabelog; March 2025). Opened 18 January 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_obanzai_ginya.notes: [Obanzai · Gion by the Kamo, a proprietress’s counter] A cosy obanzai counter facing the Kamo River in Gion, where the proprietress chats in Kyoto dialect and the head chef sends out platters of obanzai, sardine-roll sashimi, oden, saba sushi and sukiyaki, with dry Yamagata sake. Reservations essential; closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: The official site refers to the okami (proprietress). Reviewers describe a friendly owner with charming Kyoto dialect and a head chef in charge of the food (March 2025); one calls the owner beautiful and a joy to talk to (March 2025). The owner explained that the sake is mostly from Yamagata because guests prefer dry sake (February 2025).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 guest on a second visit was remembered by name.
A January 2025 diner ordered every obanzai on the board and stayed from 18:00 to about 21:00.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園おばんざい ぎんや、18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜・祝日休み、鯖寿司、いわしの梅煮、おでんの盛り合わせ、カウンターと個室、女将。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区弁財天町14 エクセタコート1F、祇園四条駅9番出口から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、日祝休み、お通し代あり、カード・電子マネー可、14席 (カウンター8、座敷4〜6)、2024年1月18日オープン。口コミ (2025年、英語): 予約必須で飛び込み不可、ピリ辛こんにゃく、おから、貝の煮物、ポテサラ、きんぴら、菜の花の辛子和え、海老芋の炊いたん、いわしの巻物の刺身、よこわのたたき、地鶏や牛の刺身、だし巻き、白魚の天ぷら、カキフライ、鹿のステーキ、A5和牛のすき焼きとうどん、山形の辛口の日本酒、京ことばの女将、料理長。

On Yamato-oji south of Shijo near Kyoto Ebisu Shrine (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_okashi_kagijin.notes: [Wagashi · Yamato-oji by Ebisu Shrine, since 1921] An old neighbourhood wagashi shop beside Kyoto Ebisu Shrine, famous for the Ebisu-yaki it bakes out front during the New Year Toka Ebisu (¥250), with seasonal sweets through the year — chewy rice-flour ayu, sakura mochi, white-miso mizu-yokan. Takeaway; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2025 reviewer calls it a wagashi shop founded in 1921 that now styles its name “Kagi Jin”, with live demonstrations of Ebisu-yaki at the festival stall.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 worshipper lined up before opening after returning the old lucky bamboo at Toka Ebisu.
An October 2025 passer-by caught the Ebisu-yaki on sale out of season for the Ebisu festival.

kyoto_platinum_beef_gion.notes: [Steak bar · Gion] A calm second-floor steak bar off Yamatooji serving tender lean wagyu — three cuts chosen by the chef — with yukhoe, roast-beef salad and pasta, and wine; the owner speaks English. About ¥10,000–15,000 at night. ¥490 charge; strict cancellation fees.

chef_bio.background: A Gion steak bar; reviewers describe a kind owner who speaks English (July and August 2025).

anecdotes.text: Three men aged 50 to 69 planning a trip in October 2026 expected tough lean beef from the price and found the chef's 600 g of three cuts juicy and tender.
A regular since 2023 calls it a choice for special days: lean meat that never feels heavy (July 2026).
A May 2025 diner had the three-cut steak omakase and planned to try the takeaway katsu sandwich next.

Dropping in at 16:00 in February 2026 for an early drink, a visitor squeezed in and had boiled and pan-fried dumplings and mapo tofu.

kyoto_wa_fujitate_gion.notes: [Japanese set lunches · Gion] A clean little Japanese restaurant just south of Shijo with good-value lunches — a shrimp tempura bowl or simmered sea-bream set for about ¥1,100 — and seasonal dishes like grilled ayu and steamed eel rice with sake at night, upstairs on tatami for groups. On a second stop in October 2025, a diner ordered shrimp omurice, mushroom cream spaghetti and the three-colour set.

kyoto_gion_hakken.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish- and beef-based course cooked with dashi (2024–2025 reviews).

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only Japanese restaurant and izakaya with private rooms off Yamato-oji in Gion. Reviewers in 2024–2025 describe one omakase course in subtle Kyoto seasoning, attentive hospitality and use for business entertaining.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 guest noted the course is omakase only, beginning with sashimi and side dishes drawn from a box in a very Kyoto presentation.
A December 2024 diner traced the course from hassun to dessert and called it an incredible value, the seasoning subtle and of a piece.
A September 2025 work gathering singled out the Omi beef and mushroom shabu-shabu.

kyoto_pizza_strada_gion.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:30, last order 22:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — queues and a full counter soon after opening (Tabelog; December 2025, March 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 50 seats: an 11-seat counter facing the oven and tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; December 2025). kyoto_pizza_strada_gion.notes: [Pizza · Gion, Yamato-oji south of Shijo] The Kyoto branch of Azabu-Juban's Pizza Strada: a stone oven at the counter turning out thin, chewy, crisp-edged pizzas — Margherita, smoked mozzarella, Bismarck — with marinated antipasti and an Aperol spritz. Busy; book ahead. Some found it pricey, and one February 2026 guest was moved seats twice and found the pizza average. Open all day.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the Kyoto Gion branch, opened 22 October 2025, of the Pizza Strada pizzeria from Azabu-Juban, Tokyo, with a stone oven by the counter. Website pizzastrada.jp (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner who had checked the site during construction arrived at opening, filled the counter seats with the first wave, and found it delicious but pricey.
A February 2026 guest who booked a table was asked twice to move to the counter, found the pizza average, and would not return because of the service.
A March 2026 visitor enjoyed watching the dough being made at the counter and called the crust authentically Neapolitan.

kyoto_peek_a_boo_cafe_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh seasonal fruit juices and smoothies; most food is cheese, meat or egg (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_peek_a_boo_cafe_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 19:00–4:00, last order 3:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations by phone, Monday–Saturday 17:00–4:00 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 24 seats: a 12-seat counter and private rooms for up to 12, including a sunken-table room with karaoke at ¥5,000 for two hours (Tabelog; June 2026). 4F of the Gion Sun building, on Tominaga-cho just east of Nawate; 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_peek_a_boo_cafe_gion.notes: [Dining bar · Gion, till 4 a.m.] A hidden fourth-floor bar-cafe off Nawate, open till 4 a.m., with a pizza oven: buffalo-mozzarella Margherita, a wagyu katsu sandwich, omurice and egg sandwiches, fresh fruit juices and cocktails, and a back room with karaoke. A charming master; no cover charge. Some found it fairly standard, one the katsu sandwich too rare. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian dining bar opened 1 July 2016 in Gion, with an oven for pizza, buffalo mozzarella and a wagyu katsu sandwich, and private rooms with karaoke. Reviewers from 2016 to 2026 describe a late, relaxed place with a charming master.

anecdotes.text: A March 2019 fan always has the seasonal fresh juice, and came this time for the oven-baked marshmallow dessert pizza.
A December 2025 second-stop visitor found it quite standard for a Gion bar, though fairly priced.
A June 2026 guest enjoyed the steak sandwich but found the katsu sandwich too rare to bite through, and noted karaoke in the back room.

kyoto_pontocho_karaku.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, yudofu and sesame tofu, but also tempura and seasoned simmered dishes; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_karaku.vegan_detail: Ask. Spicy konnyaku, sesame tofu and yudofu appear, but dashi and fish are common (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_karaku.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 18:00–23:00; Friday–Saturday 18:00–24:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; often full at weekends (Tabelog; March 2023). Food takes a while — staff warn of a wait from order to plate (August 2022). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR; non-smoking (Tabelog). Upstairs, down a narrow alley in Pontocho south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; August 2022, March 2023).
kyoto_pontocho_karaku.notes: [Obanzai · Pontocho south of Sanjo, upstairs] A tucked-away second-floor restaurant down a Pontocho alley where a gentle chef serves gently seasoned obanzai, sashimi, summer hamo shabu-shabu and a Pontocho course with yudofu and wagyu, with Kyoto sake in cut-glass cups. Welcoming to solo diners. Expect a wait for dishes — come unhurried.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews (2022–2025): a regional-cuisine restaurant upstairs in a Pontocho alley, with a gentle chef, friendly staff and an owner who chooses the sake and shochu; recommended by local bar owners.

anecdotes.text: An August 2022 visitor, sent by the owner of a nearby bar, was warned on arrival to expect a long wait between ordering and the food.
An August 2024 guest back after the Okuribi fires for a second year was greeted by the same server as the year before.
A November 2023 diner chose a kiriko cup for Sawaya Matsumoto sake after a little of every obanzai.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 郷土料理、中京区先斗町三条下る材木町188-7、月〜木・日 18:00〜23:00、金・土 18:00〜24:00、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙。口コミ (2022年8月〜2025年12月、英語): 先斗町の細い路地の奥の2階、近くのバーの店主の紹介、注文から料理まで時間がかかると最初に言われる、やさしい料理人、おばんざいの盛り合わせ (ピリ辛こんにゃく、なすとにしん、胡麻豆腐)、刺身、夏のはもしゃぶ、先斗町コース (おばんざい4種、刺身、小鉢、湯豆腐、黒毛和牛の鉄板焼き、季節の天ぷら、ご飯、漬物、デザート)、京都の地酒 (Sawaya Matsumoto)、切子のおちょこを選べる、焼酎、1人でも入りやすい。

kyoto_burlesque_umekoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef patties, cheese and pulled pork (reviews).
kyoto_burlesque_umekoji.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday; closed Thursday and Saturday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 15 seats including about four tables and a sofa by the salon window (Tabelog; February 2024; February 2025). Smoking allowed per Tabelog. Pets welcome inside (December 2025). A burger shop at the front with a hair salon at the back (2022–2025 reviews). About 10 min walk from JR Umekoji Kyoto-Nishi Stn, 300 m from Umekoji Park (Tabelog; August 2025).
kyoto_burlesque_umekoji.notes: [Burgers · near Umekoji Park, smash burgers beside a hair salon] A stylish, jazz-playing burger counter that shares its space with a hair salon at the back — easy to mistake for a salon from outside. Juicy smash burgers with grilled onions on sesame buns, no lettuce or tomato, about ¥1,200–1,500. Dogs welcome inside. Handy after the Kyoto Aquarium. Closed Thursday and Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2017–2025) describe an American-style burger shop at the entrance of a space that also houses a hair salon, with the hours written discreetly in English; the website name dates from 2015.

anecdotes.text: An eleven-time regular (March 2024) insists Burlesque is the place for smash burgers, especially the double onion.
A December 2023 passer-by had long taken it for a beauty salon before spotting the opening hours in English.
A December 2025 first-timer came with a dog, glad pets are welcome inside in winter.

kyoto_maha_curry.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: curry sets come with wheat naan, and cheese naan is the favourite (reviews).
kyoto_maha_curry.vegan_detail: Ask. A June 2024 reviewer says the restaurant caters to vegetarians; vegan dishes are not described (reviews).
kyoto_maha_curry.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last food order 21:30), daily (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: an 8-seat counter and a table downstairs, and a 10-seat sunken-kotatsu table upstairs; smoking allowed per Tabelog. Staff from India, per 2024 reviewers. 3 min walk from the Kitashirakawa bus stop, on the way to Ginkaku-ji (Tabelog; April 2024).
kyoto_maha_curry.notes: [Indian curry · Kitashirakawa near Ginkaku-ji, cheap cheese naan] A friendly, bargain Indian curry house on the road to Ginkaku-ji, busy with students: a curry-and-naan lunch for ¥590, or ¥790 with a gooey, slightly sweet cheese naan. Upstairs is a sunken-kotatsu table in an old-house room. Open daily, lunch and dinner; cash only.

roles: Staff from India per 2024 reviewers; names not given
chef_bio.background: Opened 5 February 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2026) describe friendly Indian staff, a Nepali-style noodle dish on the menu, an upstairs sunken-kotatsu room, and prices that suit the student neighbourhood.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 diner was on a third cheese naan and still found the slight sweetness addictive.
A November 2025 visitor came because a parent wanted curry with naan, and called it high value near Ginkaku-ji.
A June 2024 reviewer liked that the curries are not overly salty or greasy and the naan not oversized.

kyoto_ikazuchi_udon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broth, chicken tempura and eel toppings (reviews).
kyoto_ikazuchi_udon.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 Wednesday–Sunday; dinner 18:00–19:30 Wednesday and Thursday only; closed Monday, Tuesday and some other days; closes when the noodles sell out (Tabelog). No reservations — expect a short queue; noodles can run out by 13:30 at weekends (February and June 2026). Groups of up to four recommended (August 2026). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 16 seats; non-smoking; babies welcome (Tabelog). Right by the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop on Shirakawa-dori just north of Imadegawa (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_ikazuchi_udon.notes: [Udon · Ginkakuji-michi, hand-made udon with chicken tempura] A small, busy udon shop at the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop: firm, chewy homemade noodles in a clean natural dashi, best known for chicken (kashiwa) tempura bukkake with grated daikon; a daily special and, in summer, grilled eel with yuba. Around ¥1,000–2,000. Arrive early — it sells out. Lunch Wednesday–Sunday, short dinners Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 12 November 2018 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2026) describe udon with natural dashi and homemade noodles, a queue and early sell-outs.

anecdotes.text: A six-time regular (July 2026) makes an annual tradition of the grilled eel with yuba in chilled broth.
A February 2026 diner arrived on a Sunday after 13:00; by 13:30 the noodles had sold out for those further back.
An April 2026 guest was gently warned the regular chicken tempura bukkake is a big portion.

kyoto_kissa_to_pan_do.vegan_detail: Ask. Some breads may be plain, but ingredients are not described (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_to_pan_do.hours_raw: 9:00–16:00 Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday; closed Monday, Thursday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings accepted (Tabelog); often full, and breads sell out by early afternoon (2023–2026 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: tables and a 5-seat counter; non-smoking; breads to take away (Tabelog). At the Shirakawa-dori and Imadegawa crossing, 2 min walk from the Ginkakujimichi bus stop (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_kissa_to_pan_do.notes: [Bakery café · Kitashirakawa near Ginkakuji-michi, sourdough and chai] A calm bakery café at the Shirakawa-Imadegawa crossing, on the way to Ginkaku-ji but without a touristy feel: soft, chewy sourdough and English muffins, warmed if you like, with an unsweetened spicy chai or homemade lemonade. Breads sell out by early afternoon. Open 9:00–16:00, four days a week.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a café that bakes its own bread and serves coffee, popular enough to be full at most times.

anecdotes.text: A spring 2024 walker on the Philosopher’s Path was greeted by the smell of freshly baked bread at the door.
An October 2024 lunch visitor found four groups ahead and only one kind of sandwich left.
A January 2026 visitor found every seat booked and took bread home instead.

kyoto_sferabar_satonaka.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail, whisky and wine bar; no food or gluten information (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sferabar_satonaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks only in the reviews (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sferabar_satonaka.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 19:00–4:00; closed Sunday (open on the Sunday of a long weekend, closed on its last day); hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥525 at the counter, ¥1,050 at a table (Tabelog original カウンター席 \525、テーブル席 \1,050). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 20 seats: a long counter and sofa booths; smoking allowed (Tabelog; November 2014). 3F of the Sfera building between Kawabata and Nawate north of Shinbashi, by a hard-to-find lift (Tabelog; 2014–2020 reviews). Opened 23 December 2006 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sferabar_satonaka.notes: [Cocktail bar · Gion, Nawate-Shinbashi, till 4 a.m.] A sleek, quiet bar on the third floor of the Sfera design building, with a long counter, sofa booths, maiko fans on the walls, a deep whisky shelf and stylish cocktails. Open late; take the hidden lift. Seat charge ¥525 at the counter, ¥1,050 at a table. Smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar opened 23 December 2006 in the Sfera building. A February 2017 reviewer explains that Sfera is a Kyoto design brand founded in 2001, whose building also holds Cafe DOnG by Sfera (in data).

anecdotes.text: A November 2014 visitor found the counter and box seats a calm slice of Kyoto, the whisky impressive and the cocktails extraordinarily stylish.
A September 2020 guest noted the lift is in a slightly hard-to-find spot, and chose a cocktail over the many wines.
A September 2026 visitor noticed many maiko fans displayed around the room.

kyoto_cafe_grayish_green.notes: [Mint cafe · south of Gion, by Instagram reservation] A tiny, green-and-white cafe devoted to mint, run by one mint-loving owner who grows it in the courtyard: delicate mint parfaits, choco-mint and seasonal plates like sakura and mint, and mint-scented water. Open irregularly — reserve and pre-order by Instagram DM. Cash only.

roles: Owner, who runs the cafe alone (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews (2022–2026): a mint-sweets cafe opened 12 February 2021, run by one owner passionate about mint, who grows mint in the courtyard and takes reservations by Instagram.
chef_bio.philosophy: Desserts made with home-grown mint and natural flavours (2022 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2022 visitor who grows mint at home was greeted by the scent of mint on entering, and by mint-infused water.
An April 2024 diner explained the routine: DM on Instagram to reserve a seat and order in advance, as the shop opens only occasionally.
In April 2026 the owner warned that the sakura jelly under the sakura and mint parfait might not suit everyone; the reviewer found it a subtle taste of spring.

kyoto_kyoryori_tazuru.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki seasoned with dashi and soy — sashimi, grilled ayu, eel, saba sushi in bamboo leaf; no gluten information (2017–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kyoryori_tazuru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-based kaiseki course with dashi (2017–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kyoryori_tazuru.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 20:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards; no QR (Tabelog). 50 seats with tatami banquet rooms and private rooms for 10–20; karaoke; bring-your-own drinks allowed (Tabelog). The restaurant of a long-established ryokan on Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, backing onto the Kamo River, with a summer river terrace (noryo-yuka) looking toward Higashiyama (Tabelog; 2017–2025 reviews). Non-staying guests dine here for lunches, business dinners and events (2019–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kyoryori_tazuru.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, on the Kamo River] The restaurant of an old ryokan on the Kamo River, open to non-guests: dashi-rich, delicately seasoned Kyoto kaiseki brought by kimono-clad staff in tatami rooms, or in summer out on the river terrace facing Higashiyama — grilled ayu, eel, saba sushi in bamboo leaf. Good for business dinners and banquets.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews (2017–2025): the Kyoto-cuisine restaurant of a historic ryokan on the Kamo River between Gion-Shijo and Kiyomizu-Gojo, with a summer noryo-yuka terrace, banquet rooms and private rooms.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki on the summer river terrace.

anecdotes.text: A September 2019 diner walked through the inn to the river terrace as the sun set over Higashiyama, starting with saba sushi in bamboo leaf on a lacquered tray.
A July 2023 networking dinner was kept off the terrace by rain but enjoyed the room's summer platform.
A June 2025 business dinner found the early-June terrace a little chilly but the sweetfish and eel excellent.

kyoto_izutsuya_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef sukiyaki restaurant (2025–2026 reviews).

On Pontocho south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo or Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 November 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_izutsuya_pontocho.notes: [Sukiyaki · Pontocho by the Kamo River] A calm, upscale sukiyaki house on Pontocho, run by a Kyotanba meat business with its own ranch: staff cook lean or marbled beef in sweet soy with vegetables and tofu, for dipping in rich egg, with appetisers and rice to finish — or oil-grilled. Private rooms and river views; lunch too. Not cheap, but reviewers found it worth it.

roles: Staff who cook the sukiyaki at the table (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a Tanba beef and Kyoto meat sukiyaki restaurant opened 20 November 2023 on Pontocho. The site says Izutsuya has 75 years in Kyotanba (京丹波で75年), raises cattle on its own ranch and runs restaurants to feed diners' views back into production.
chef_bio.philosophy: From its own ranch to the table, with diners' views fed back into production (official site).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 family of five marked a second anniversary with the ¥10,000 course in a private room, with plenty of matsutake.
An August 2026 visitor too late to book the riverside seats was told to come anyway, and got a table by the river.
A September 2026 diner called it not cheap but worth it for the food, room and sense of occasion.

kyoto_gohanya_kiki.notes: [Obanzai & sake · Shijo basement] A friendly basement izakaya run by two women, popular with regulars: obanzai and oden, grilled chicken with sansho and a memorable omakase fried rice to finish, with Kyoto sake picked to your taste. About ¥5,000–8,000. Book courses the day before.

chef_bio.background: Run by two women (May and November 2025 reviews). A June 2026 diner had first come when it opened about nine years earlier.

A March 2025 regular remembered the homemade fried rice at the end above all.

kyoto_shogetsu_kawaramachi.notes: [Okonomiyaki & teppan · Kawaramachi] A big, busy second-floor okonomiyaki house in the Kawaramachi arcade, one of three 将月: thick-noodle yakisoba, monjayaki, the special Shogetsu-yaki and teppan snacks, with an all-you-can-drink course from ¥3,500. About ¥2,000–4,000. Open daily; weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: One of three 将月 shops, with Ichijoji and Fukakusa (September 2026 review; HotPepper).

anecdotes.text: A regular in October 2026 filled up on spicy jumbo yakisoba, a cheese omelette and pork-shabu salad with all-you-can-drink, and never got to the okonomiyaki.
A July 2026 group of four had a 10-dish course with okonomiyaki, yakisoba and three hours of drinks for ¥3,500 each.
A solo business traveller in November 2025 came for the thick, chewy yakisoba, despite the older building.

kyoto_teppo_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Cuts can be had with salt instead of sauce, but chige and marinated dishes are on the menu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppo_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef and offal yakiniku counter (2025–26 reviews).

A small counter and tables for four; smoking allowed; a TV (Tabelog; August 2025 and July 2026 reviews). Lively with regulars around a charismatic owner, several 2025–26 reviewers note. In 花七軒 on Yamatooji south of Shijo, near Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppo_gion.notes: [Yakiniku & horumon · Gion] A cosy, sign-covered old-town yakiniku counter run by a stylish, charismatic owner who picks the day's best cuts: tongue sashimi, yukhoe, outside skirt with salt or sauce, horumon and a famous chige. About ¥6,000–15,000. Open till 1:00; smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A long-running neighbourhood yakiniku in Gion (2024–26 reviews); reviewers describe a stylish, friendly owner who chooses the meat of the day (August 2025, July 2026).

anecdotes.text: A regular of four visits by August 2025 praised the tongue sashimi, raw or lightly grilled, seasoned only with salt and pepper.
An August 2025 diner chose the omakase and was asked about preferences first.
A July 2026 diner recommends the chige as a hangover cure.

kyoto_baribari_indonesia_gion.notes: [Indonesian · Gion] A casual, long-running Indonesian kitchen on a third floor in Gion, with a shoes-off counter: addictive nasi goreng and a long menu of dishes to share, with clay-pot jasmine tea. A July 2026 diner loved the nasi goreng but was teary from kitchen smoke at the counter.

Reopened in July 2026; reviews are mixed on portions and service. ¥420 charge.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya created with Yamamoto Honke, a sake brewery founded in Fushimi in 1677, in a renovated house over 100 years old; it reopened on 8 July 2026 after renovation with a new counter and charcoal grill.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor on reopening day started with "Shinsei Ho-o", the sake offered at Yasaka Shrine, alongside the appetizer.
A July 2026 family lunch after a film tried a tasting flight and were given fu tempura without ordering it.
An October 2026 diner found portions small and the ¥3,278 sashimi for two overpriced, and the service careless.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor ordered six obanzai, then six more, and finished with the egg over rice.

Rice small, regular or large at the same price (April 2026). 28 seats: 6 at the counter downstairs; tables for two and a 14-seat counter upstairs. Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, d Barai, au PAY). On Kawaramachi below Sanjo. Opened 3 February 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nikujuu_hokusai_kawaramachi.notes: [Wagyu rice boxes · Kawaramachi below Sanjo, steak bowls under ¥2,000] A two-floor meat-bowl counter on Kawaramachi serving rare Kobe-beef steak, sukiyaki and yakiniku over Hachidaime Gihei rice with a raw yolk on top, mostly ¥1,100–1,900. Buy a ticket at the door. Very popular with overseas visitors; one January 2026 diner called it average and priced for tourists. Open daily from 11:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 February 2024 (Tabelog). The Tabelog highlights name its own-farm "Shiwase Beef", Kobe beef and Hachidaime Gihei rice. Reviewers in 2025–2026 note mostly overseas customers, quick turnover and generous rice; criticism: "just 'average'" with "somewhat aggressive" pricing (January 2026), and a sukiyaki that was "somewhat mild" (November 2025). No source links it to the duck restaurant 京の鴨料理 北斎 in Higashiyama.

anecdotes.text: August 2025: "The meat changes color as it absorbs heat from the rice over time, so be sure to take photos quickly!"
January 2026: "about 90% of the customers in the restaurant were international tourists."

kyoto_sot_l_y_laisse_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: karaage, fries, mixed noodles and chicken miso alongside the grill platters; ask about salted cuts (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sot_l_y_laisse_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a grill-it-yourself chicken and offal izakaya (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_sot_l_y_laisse_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); closing days not fixed. Reservations recommended — it fills up (April 2023; September 2026). 30 seats: tables and counter, some standing-bar style. Smoking allowed. Pets welcome; take-away. Cards and PayPay; no e-money. Ground floor of フジヨシビル on Kawaramachi above Matsubara. Opened 15 April 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sot_l_y_laisse_kawaramachi.notes: [Grill-your-own yakitori · Kawaramachi-Matsubara, shichirin and fruit sours] A dim, stylish izakaya where you grill the day's chicken yourself over a shichirin — a 10-cut platter is ¥2,500 for two — with odd, good sides like Mao Zedong karaage and seasonal fresh-fruit sours. Book ahead; open till midnight. One reviewer found it too dark to judge doneness. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 April 2014 (Tabelog); the name is the French for the chicken "oyster" cut. Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 praise value, the unusual side dishes, friendly staff who recommend sake and wine, and seasonal fruit sours; criticism: dim light makes it "somewhat difficult to gauge the cooking level" and portions may be light for big eaters (February 2026), and some chairs near the entrance lacked backs (November 2025).

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "I didn't have a reservation, but they kindly allowed me to stay for 30 minutes… we left after just a little over 30 minutes."
January 2026: "Everything was so delicious that I ordered too much and ran out of time, so I took the mixed noodles to go!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ソリレス、居酒屋、下京区河原町松原上ル清水町284 フジヨシビル 1F、阪急河原町駅・京阪清水五条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 18:00〜24:00 (料理 L.O. 23:00、ドリンク L.O. 23:30)、不定休、予約可、30席、立ち飲み、喫煙可、ペット可、テイクアウト、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、2014年4月15日オープン、朝しめた鶏を七輪で焼く焼き鳥、90分飲み放題のコース、法人会員。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 部位の盛り合わせ2人前2,500円、ホルモン入りとなし、唐揚げ「Mao Zedong」650円、ソリレスのポテサラ650円、枝豆のアーリオオーリオ550円、アボカドの塩昆布、パクチーのフライドポテト、そぼろご飯、締めの混ぜ麺、季節の生フルーツサワー (柿900円)、飲み放題コース5,000円、薄暗くて焼き加減がわかりにくい (2026年2月)、背もたれのない椅子 (2025年11月)、予約がおすすめ。

kyoto_kunisho_kawaramachi_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sauce-grilled offal, fried lung and soy-based dips (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kunisho_kawaramachi_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef offal and raw-meat counter (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kunisho_kawaramachi_sanjo.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:30–27:00 (3 am; last order 26:00); closed the third Sunday and Monday of each month and the fifth Sunday. An August 2025 blog review gives 17:30–01:00. Reservations taken; private hire for 5 or more by arrangement. 10 seats: 5 at the counter and a table for 5. Smoking allowed. BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Cards and Rakuten Pay; no e-money. 2nd floor of 六角ビル on Kawaramachi below Sanjo.
kyoto_kunisho_kawaramachi_sanjo.notes: [Horumon counter · Kawaramachi below Sanjo, offal and raw meat till 3 am] A ten-seat upstairs counter where a talkative ex-rugby-player owner serves very fresh beef offal — white omasum, heart sashimi, sauce-grilled hoso, tail soup — until 3 am, often as omakase. Not cheap, and the room is a bit worn. Smoking allowed. Closed the third Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: A September 2023 reviewer writes that "the restaurant is run solely by a charming owner, a former rugby player", and later reviewers praise the owner's talk and omakase (December 2024; November 2023). Reviewers rate the freshness of the offal and raw meat; one December 2024 diner calls the room "a bit unkempt" but with "the charm of a long-established eatery", and a February 2026 diner says prices "are not exactly cheap" but justified.

anecdotes.text: January 2019: "It may seem like just hot water blanched tripe, but oh, the texture!"
November 2023: "I couldn't get into any of the famous and popular yakiniku restaurants… after letting the owner choose various dishes for me, everything was delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 邦匠、ホルモン・居酒屋・ダイニングバー、中京区河原町三条下ル二丁目山崎町236 六角ビル 2F、京阪三条駅6番出口から徒歩5分、毎日 17:30〜翌3:00 (L.O. 翌2:00)、毎月第3日曜・月曜と第5日曜休み、予約可、5名以上で貸切相談可、10席 (カウンター5、テーブル5)、喫煙可、持ち込み可、カード・楽天ペイ可、電子マネー不可、法人会員。口コミ (2013年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 元ラガーマンの店主がひとりで営む (2023年9月)、生センマイ1,000円、揚げた脂かすの卵焼き1,000円、アギ800円、フワの唐揚げ500円、肉刺し、ハツ刺し、ホソのたれ焼き、湯がいたミノ、テールスープ、ホルモンのミックス焼き、牛すじ煮込み、おでん、おまかせ、少し雑然としている (2024年12月)、安くはないが納得の値段 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Ten-seat counter; smoking allowed; raw meat on the menu.
