kyoto_hanatanuki_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: flour-batter betayaki, okonomiyaki, monjayaki and yakisoba (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanatanuki_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: betayaki with aburakasu, pork, beef and seafood (official site; reviews).
kyoto_hanatanuki_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); open all year. Reservations taken (Tabelog bookings for two or more). Service charge 5% from 1 October 2026, courses excepted — Tabelog, Japanese original 「2026年10月1日より、サービス料として５％頂戴します（コース料理は除く）」. 52 seats with tall partitions and three private tables for 2–4; private hire 20–50. Non-smoking. Smartphone ordering; free Wi-Fi; take-away. Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay). Off Shinkyogoku below Sanjo. One of four 花たぬき shops (official site: 河原町店, 京都駅前店, 御池店, 梅津店).
kyoto_hanatanuki_kawaramachi.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Shinkyogoku below Sanjo, Kyoto betayaki and monja] A roomy, partitioned teppan house near Shinkyogoku for Kyoto-style betayaki — the house tanuki-yaki with aburakasu — cheese and Wagyu teppan dishes, and monjayaki cooked at your table, plus all-you-can-eat courses. Open noon to 11 pm daily; 5% service from October 2026. One of four local shops.

chef_bio.background: The official site calls 花たぬき a specialist in Kyoto's flour dish "betayaki" and lists four shops, of which this is one. Reviewers in 2025–2026 praise friendly, fluent staff who cook monjayaki for you, big portions and value; criticism: an hour's wait for one teppan dish (August 2025), garlic-heavy grilled horumon (September 2025), an okonomiyaki that "didn't feel particularly special" (February 2026) and a warm room (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: February 2025: "Making okonomiyaki was challenging... it ended up looking like just stir-fried vegetables."
February 2026: "Since there are few places to enjoy monjayaki in Kyoto, I highly recommend this spot."

kyoto_gion_kimutako.gf_detail: Ask. The batter includes rice flour, but whether it is wheat-free is not stated; takosen uses a cracker (K PRESS; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kimutako.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki and whole baby octopus (K PRESS; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kimutako.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–22:00, sometimes a little later; listed as closed Monday (Tuesday after a holiday) but "currently not fixed" (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). One drink per person to eat in — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「1人につき1ドリンクオーダー必須（テイクアウトの場合は免除）」 (takeaway exempt). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 8 seats — 4 at the kitchen counter, 4 facing the wall — plus a few terrace seats; non-smoking inside, smoking area outside (Tabelog). On the 1F of ラオンイン祇園縄手, 2 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kimutako.notes: [Takoyaki · Gion] A small takoyaki stand-bar near Gion-Shijo Station: big, fluffy takoyaki of rice-flour batter, a dashi version, takosen and whole baby octopus, with a beer at the counter or on the terrace. Under ¥1,000. One drink each to eat in.

chef_bio.background: Featured by Keihan's K PRESS (September 2024) for its rice-flour batter and whole-baby-octopus takoyaki.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor who thought it takeaway-only found you can eat in with one order each, and loved the fluffy, creamy rice-flour takoyaki.
Peckish five hours before dinner in December 2025, a stroller in Gion stopped for takoyaki with dashi sauce.
A September 2026 visitor on a second dinner had a nostalgic takosen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 キムタコ、たこ焼き、東山区大和町16-1 ラオンイン祇園縄手 1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、毎日 15:00〜22:00 (少し延長あり)、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌火曜) だが現在は不定、予約可、1人1ドリンク必須 (テイクアウトは免除)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、8席 (キッチンカウンター4、壁向きカウンター4) とテラス、店内禁煙・店前に喫煙所。K PRESS (2024年9月): 米粉を配合した生地、天かす多めの大きなたこ焼き、名物のイイダコ一匹焼き。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年9月、英語): ふわふわでとろとろのたこ焼き、だしのたこ焼き、たこせん、ビール。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and terrace; one drink each to eat in.

kyoto_kotoshina_chaya_bal.gf_detail: Ask. Teas and lattes are likely wheat-free, but sweets and gelato are not described (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kotoshina_chaya_bal.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic teas sweetened with agave syrup; whether plant milk is offered for lattes is not stated (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kotoshina_chaya_bal.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:45); hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). About four seats inside plus a terrace; takeaway (March, July and August 2026 reviews). On the 1F of Kyoto BAL on Kawaramachi, near the entrance (Tabelog; rurubu).
kyoto_kotoshina_chaya_bal.notes: [Organic tea stand · Kyoto BAL] A small tea stand on the ground floor of Kyoto BAL from a Kyoto organic skincare brand, using tea from its own organic garden: freshly whisked matcha latte, hojicha and chestnut-azuki lattes (about ¥880), sencha and tea sodas, sweetened to taste with agave. Open daily 11:00–20:00.

roles: Tea stand of KOTOSHINA (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 13 July 2024 (Tabelog) by the Kyoto organic skincare brand KOTOSHINA, launched in 2012 (rurubu; Leaf Kyoto). Tea comes from the brand's own organic JAS-certified garden in Wazuka (rurubu); a March 2026 reviewer names the garden as Nagata Tea Garden in Uji-Tawara.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor watched the staff's practised movements while having a matcha latte and a chestnut azuki-tea latte on the warm terrace.
A March 2026 visitor found the organic sencha refined, perhaps too much so, over three brews.
An August 2026 regular switched from the hojicha latte to the matcha latte and loved its aroma, sweetened with agave.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: KOTOSHINA茶屋、ティースタンド、中京区河原町通三条下ル2-山崎町251 京都BAL 1F、毎日 11:00〜20:00 (L.O. 19:45)、予約不可、2024年7月13日オープン。るるぶ: 京都のオーガニックスキンケアブランド KOTOSHINA のティースタンド、和束町の自社の有機 JAS の茶畑。Leaf Kyoto (英語): 2012年に始まったブランド。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 宇治抹茶ラテ880円、和栗のあずき茶ラテ880円、ほうじ茶ラテ、和紅茶ラテ、黒蜜きなこ抹茶ラテ、いちごと和菓子の限定抹茶ラテ、ブルーベリーほうじ茶ラテ、三煎まで楽しめる煎茶、ソーダ、玄米茶のジェラート、アガベシロップで甘さを調整、店内4席とテラス、Uji-Tawara の茶園の名を挙げる声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; takeaway.

kyoto_korin_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and grilled fish, but tempura, nama-fu skewers and soy-seasoned sides feature (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_korin_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, tempura, ginger pork and dashi-based sides (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_korin_miyagawacho.hours_raw: Tue 17:00–22:00; Wed–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; lunch queues from opening, with numbered tickets (Tabelog; January and June 2025 reviews). Table charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージ料200円」 (¥200). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 35 seats: a counter of 5, raised tatami with sunken seating, and a private room for 4–10 (Tabelog). On stone-paved Miyagawacho, 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_korin_miyagawacho.notes: [Kyoto set meals · Miyagawacho] A friendly Kyoto restaurant on stone-paved Miyagawacho with a queue at lunch for its ¥1,300 sashimi-and-tempura set and ten-odd others, and evening courses of sesame tofu, nama-fu, sashimi and tempura around ¥6,000 with drinks. ¥200 charge; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: A Miyagawacho restaurant; a November 2025 business-dinner guest was impressed by the owner's stories.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor, in Kyoto for the birthday of a geisha the visitor supports, arrived at 11:30 opening to find three people already waiting.
A December 2025 regular arrived before opening and found the ginger pork portion almost too generous.
Booking ahead for cherry-blossom season in April 2026, a returning guest had the dashi soup, kinpira and big shrimp tempura again.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 光琳、日本料理、東山区宮川筋3丁目285、京阪四条駅1番出口から徒歩5分、火 17:00〜22:00、水〜土 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、日月休み、予約可、チャージ料200円、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、35席 (カウンター5、掘りごたつの小上がり、4〜10名の個室)。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年4月、英語): 宮川町の石畳、昼は開店前から行列と整理券、10種以上の昼の定食、刺身と天ぷら (海老か鱧) の光琳ランチ1,300円、高野豆腐ときんぴら、生姜焼き定食、上品なだしの吸い物、夜のコース (胡麻豆腐、麩の串、刺身、天ぷら、焼き魚、季節の料理)、飲み放題付きで約6,000円、店主の話。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch queue with numbered tickets.

kyoto_yakiniku_nishiki_henkotsu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_nishiki_henkotsu.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); may close early when ingredients run out; irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken; courses must be booked by the day before (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料・チャージ料なし」 (none). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 45 seats, partitioned for groups of 2 to 45 (Tabelog). Mobile ordering (December 2025 review). On Tominokoji just north of Nishiki, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_nishiki_henkotsu.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · near Nishiki] A roomy yakiniku just north of Nishiki on Tominokoji, popular for parties: kuroge wagyu courses with drinks from about ¥5,300, thick-cut tongue, wagyu sashimi and rare horumon, finished with fluffy egg fried rice. No service or cover charge.

chef_bio.background: A yakiniku restaurant near Nishiki Market (Tabelog; Gurunavi). Unrelated to へんこつ, the beef-stew oden shop already listed.

anecdotes.text: A last-minute group of eleven in June 2025 got a booking for the 12-dish course, which opened with beef sashimi.
A June 2025 diner was surprised by egg fried rice as the course's finale and found it fluffy and delicious.
An August 2026 diner on the ¥10,000 course was unimpressed by the salad and namul but happy with the meat.

kyoto_vodka_bar_nakanishi_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Vodka bar snacks such as pirozhki (wheat dough), raisin-butter sandwiches, oil sardines and crackers; no gluten information (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_vodka_bar_nakanishi_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: snacks include pirozhki, butter sandwiches and oil sardines (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_vodka_bar_nakanishi_pontocho.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). A small counter of about eight seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2011). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, east side, with matryoshka dolls in the window; the Pontocho Kaburenjo is just north (2010–2014 reviews).
kyoto_vodka_bar_nakanishi_pontocho.notes: [Vodka bar · Pontocho, matryoshka in the window] A tiny, long-standing Russian vodka bar on Pontocho: rows of vodka and matryoshka behind a counter of about eight, a lively master who once worked at Tokyo's Russian restaurant Kieff, and snacks like pirozhki (not in high summer) and raisin-butter sandwiches. A grown-up bar with grown-up prices. Smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2008–2025): Vodka Bar Nakanishi, a Pontocho counter bar devoted to vodka; an October 2015 reviewer learned the master worked at Kieff in Tokyo, known for Russian cooking.

anecdotes.text: A May 2011 guest back after seven years found the room and the master unchanged, and the raisin-butter sandwiches as good as remembered.
A June 2019 visitor met a sign: pirozhki finished for the hot season, back from October.
A June 2011 reviewer thought ¥1,400 a drink made it a place for adults and connoisseurs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区先斗町通三条下ル若松町138-4、火〜日 18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー可、喫煙可。口コミ (2008年11月〜2025年12月、英語): ウォッカバー・ナカニシ、窓にマトリョーシカ、歌舞練場の南の東側、ウォッカの瓶がずらり、切り絵の額、8席ほどのカウンター、元気なマスター (東京のロシア料理店 Kieff で働いていたとの声)、ウォッカマティーニ、1杯1,400円ほど (2011年6月)、ピロシキ (夏は休み、10月から)、レーズンバターサンド、オイルサーディンとクラッカー。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter bar; smoking allowed; cards.

kyoto_gion_sekiya.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese courses and à la carte — sashimi, smoked fish, simmered dishes; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_sekiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred kappo (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_sekiya.hours_raw: Dinner from 17:30 until late; lunch by reservation only; irregular closing days — call before visiting (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and the owner tries to accommodate bookings outside regular hours (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats plus a semi-private room; run by the owner alone (Tabelog; March 2023). Room 202 on the 2F of the Kusaoen building, Tominaga-cho in north Gion; 2–5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; March 2023). Opened 26 March 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sekiya.notes: [Kappo · north Gion, counter] An eight-seat counter on the second floor of a Gion dining building, run single-handed by the owner: beautiful seasonal appetisers, sashimi by the piece and a choice of course or à la carte, at gentler prices than many Gion kappo. Lunch by reservation; dinner from 17:30 into the night; call ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: GION SEKIYA, opened 26 March 2018 on the 2F of the Kusaoen building, reflecting the owner's wish to offer casual Japanese cuisine in Gion. A March 2023 reviewer notes the owner runs it alone.

anecdotes.text: A December 2022 visitor drawn by the à la carte option was handed a warm sake-lees soup on the house while choosing.
A March 2023 diner found the spring appetisers, with cherry-blossom touches, luxurious, and noted the owner runs the counter alone.
A December 2024 party of five on a third visit ordered à la carte, with omakase sashimi one serving at a time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区富永町132 草園ビル 2F 202、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分ほど、昼は予約のみ、夜は17:30〜深夜、予約に応じて営業時間外も対応、不定休 (来店前に電話を)、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席と半個室、2018年3月26日開店、祇園で気軽な和食をという店主の思い、公式サイト gionsekiya.com。口コミ (2020年2月〜2025年12月、英語): 祇園北側のビルの2階、店主が1人で営む、コースとアラカルト、彩りの前菜 (燻製の魚、金柑の甘煮、春は桜の演出)、おまかせの刺身、冬のサービスの粕汁、大人の隠れ家。

cultural_comfort.note: Eight-seat counter; call ahead; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and website; reviews through December 2025.

kyoto_imo_matsu_kita_bekkan.gf_detail: Not GF: an all-you-can-eat izakaya menu with hot pots finished with udon, fried dishes and desserts (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_imo_matsu_kita_bekkan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: crab hot pot, chicken sukiyaki, sushi and izakaya dishes (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_imo_matsu_kita_bekkan.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 18:00–1:00 (last order 24:00); Friday, Saturday and the day before a holiday 17:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sunday and holidays 17:00–1:00 (last order 24:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised, even on Sundays (Tabelog; March 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), but not for courses; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 86 seats; private hire possible; food ordered from staff, drinks by QR code; weak phone signal in the basement but Wi-Fi provided (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). B1F of the New Kyoto building, Kiyamachi south of Sanjo; 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 November 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_imo_matsu_kita_bekkan.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, all you can eat and drink] A big basement izakaya built for groups, with all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from about ¥3,600 — crab hot pot with udon and zosui in winter, dashimaki, chicken sukiyaki and hand-rolled sushi, plenty of shochu — of better quality than the price suggests, per reviewers. Dishes can be slow for big parties. Open late; book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya, seafood and hot-pot restaurant of 86 seats opened 1 November 2022; a いも松 木屋町店 also appears in our crawls. Reviewers in 2023–2026 describe quick, well-trained service and all-you-can-eat courses of good quality.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 group on the all-you-can-eat crab course finished with both udon and zosui, and praised the well-trained staff.
A March 2025 diner, wary of suspiciously cheap all-you-can-eat places, found the dashimaki and pudding genuinely good from ¥3,600.
A September 2026 party on the premium course ordered food from staff and drinks by QR code, and found dishes a little slow for a big group.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、中京区材木町181-2 ニュー京都ビル B1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩4分、月〜木 18:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.24:00)、金・土・祝前日 17:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:00)、日・祝 17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.24:00)、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可だがコースは不可、電子マネー・QR 不可、86席、貸切可、2022年11月1日開店。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 食べ飲み放題3,600円から、5,000円の食べ飲み放題、全品注文できるプレミアムコース、かに鍋の食べ放題 (締めにうどんと雑炊)、だし巻き、鶏すき焼きと手巻き寿司のセット、プリンなどのデザート、焼酎が豊富 (ロック、水割り、お湯割り、ソーダ割り)、料理は口頭、飲み物は QR で注文、地下で電波が弱いが Wi-Fi あり、大人数だと料理が遅いとの声、日曜でも予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Group-friendly; drinks by QR code; courses not payable by card.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_oden_teppan_kitoma.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in dashi alongside gyoza, teppan dishes and fried items; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oden_teppan_kitoma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, lamb gyoza, shrimp dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oden_teppan_kitoma.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:00–23:00, last order 22:30; closed Sunday — on a Saturday-to-Monday long weekend it opens Sunday and closes Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for 20–30 by phone (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥330 incl. tax (Tabelog original お通し代330円(税込)を頂戴しております。). Cards, iD and QR (Tabelog). Two tables and a counter up a steep staircase; drinks are self-service from the fridge at one price — spill and you pay double (September 2024). 2F of the Nichiho Ayanokoji Center, upstairs from ざきやま; 5 min walk from Karasuma or Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
kyoto_oden_teppan_kitoma.notes: [Oden izakaya · Ayanokoji, self-serve drinks] A friendly little upstairs izakaya where you help yourself to sake, beer and highballs from the fridge at one price — careful, a spill costs double — and order oden in a gentle broth all year, lamb and celery gyoza, tomato oden and Kujo-negi dashimaki. Run by a couple, per a 2024 review. ¥330 appetizer; closed Sunday.

roles: Owners (unnamed; a couple, per a September 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an oden, teppanyaki and gyoza izakaya on the 2F of the Nichiho Ayanokoji Center, with around twelve seasonal sakes and self-service drinks. A September 2024 reviewer describes a friendly couple running it; a February 2025 reviewer found it run that night by one person, still quick.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 visitor warned that drinks come self-service from the fridge — spill a drop and you pay for two.
A December 2025 girls' night started with a whole shrimp as the appetizer, then tomato oden and miso-mayo shrimp.
A July 2026 visitor came for oden in summer with chilled sake and the lamb and celery gyoza.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・おでん・餃子、下京区綾材木町201-2 日宝綾小路センター 2F、阪急烏丸駅・河原町駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜休み (土〜月の3連休は日曜営業・月曜休み)、予約可、貸切20〜30名は電話で、お通し代330円 (税込)、カード・iD・QR 可、季節の日本酒12種ほど、一部セルフサービスの飲み物。口コミ (2024年9月〜2026年8月、英語): ざきやまの2階、急な階段、テーブル2つとカウンター、気さくなご夫婦 (2024年9月)、冷蔵庫から取る均一料金のセルフの日本酒・ビール・缶チューハイ、こぼすと2杯分、やさしいだしのおでん、トマトおでん、ラムとセロリの焼き餃子、九条ねぎのあんかけだし巻き、海老のみそマヨ、海老の酒蒸し、ポテトサラダ、レッドアイ750円。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-serve drinks; steep stairs; ¥330 appetizer; cards, iD and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_sundays_coffee_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask: coffee and hojicha may suit; kaya toast, croissant and cheesecake do not (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sundays_coffee_nishiki.vegan_detail: Ask: black filter coffee may suit; ask about plant milk for lattes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sundays_coffee_nishiki.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 08:00–18:00; closed Monday; hours may change. No reservations. Cashless — cards and QR only, no cash (August 2026 review; Tabelog lists cards, e-money and QR). Few seats, benches only, no tables (August 2026). Non-smoking. In an 80-year-old renovated machiya down a narrow alley near Nishiki Market — easy to miss (December 2025; April and May 2026). Open about a year as of August 2026.
kyoto_sundays_coffee_nishiki.notes: [Specialty coffee · alley by Nishiki Market, kaya toast from 8 am] A quiet coffee bar in an 80-year-old machiya tucked down an alley off Nishiki: hand-drip or espresso from beans you pick with the barista, Singaporean kaya toast and a few cakes. Benches only, card or QR only, from about ¥700 a cup. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from December 2025 to October 2026 describe a café opened about a year before (August 2026) in a renovated 80-year-old townhouse, named for the wish to drink coffee "as if it were a holiday" (December 2025), with art by Shiga artists on the walls and friendly staff who help choose beans. One April 2026 reviewer found prices "a bit on the higher side" for the location.
chef_bio.philosophy: Coffee as if every day were a Sunday (December 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-drip coffee from chosen beans; kaya toast.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "What's fun here is that you can choose your own coffee beans! If you're unsure which to pick, you can ask for advice, and you can even select the beans for your latte."
May 2026: "It was a bit tricky to find as it was tucked away behind the building, but I'm glad I made it!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Sundays Coffee、カフェ、中京区十文字町455-5、烏丸から412m、火〜日 8:00〜18:00、月曜休み、時間は変わることがある、予約不可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 錦市場近くの路地、築80年の町家を改装、エスプレッソ、コールドブリュー、ハンドドリップ、豆を選べる (FURUTA など)、コーヒーは700円から、カヤトースト、レアチーズケーキ、平たいクロワッサン、ほうじ茶、現金不可でカードとQR (2026年8月)、ベンチ席のみ、滋賀の作家の作品、開店から約1年 (2026年8月)、場所の割にやや高め (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; cashless; staff help choose beans.

kyoto_ouchi_gohan_nakashimaya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, fries, menchi-katsu, fried horse mackerel and soy-simmered obanzai (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ouchi_gohan_nakashimaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito dashi is served to start and finish, and most obanzai use it (May and September 2026).
kyoto_ouchi_gohan_nakashimaya.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:30 (food last order 22:30, drinks 23:00); closing days not fixed. Reservations taken; often near full (September 2026). Appetizer fee ¥440 including tax — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し代：税込440円」. 36 seats: 8 at the counter and 28 at sunken-kotatsu tables over two floors (a semi-private room for 10–12 downstairs); steep stairs to the 2nd floor (April 2026). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi. Cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). A renovated townhouse on Bukkoji-higashi-machi between Karasuma and Kawaramachi. A second shop has opened at Sanjo-Kiyamachi (April 2026).
kyoto_ouchi_gohan_nakashimaya.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Bukkoji between Shijo and Kawaramachi, Kyoto home cooking] A busy townhouse izakaya with sunken-kotatsu tables, starting and ending with a cup of bonito dashi and serving plates of Kyoto obanzai — try the corn tempura in season — with good sake and a Manganji-pepper sour. ¥440 appetizer charge. Some find it average or a little salty. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe young, energetic staff, a friendly owner who chats while cooking and made rice balls off the menu ("They're not on the menu, but I can make them for you", August 2026), and a growing share of overseas guests; a second shop has opened at Sanjo-Kiyamachi (April 2026). Criticism: sashimi with "a slight fishy smell" (May 2026), food "average" next to the setting (May 2026), slightly salty simmered dishes (September 2026) and prices "a bit on the higher side" (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: August 2026: on the last night of Obon, a guest asked for rice balls; "He replied, 'They're not on the menu, but I can make them for you'".
September 2026: "To start, we were served a small cup of dashi (broth)… At the end, we were treated to a warm bowl of this dashi as a soup."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おうちごはん 中島家、居酒屋・日本料理、下京区仏光寺東町115、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩10分、阪急河原町駅から徒歩8分、毎日 17:00〜23:30 (料理 L.O. 22:30、ドリンク L.O. 23:00)、不定休、予約可、原文で「お通し代：税込440円」、36席 (カウンター8、掘りごたつ28、1階に10〜12名の半個室)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR可、法人会員。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 町家のおばんざい居酒屋、最初と最後に枕崎のかつおだし、とろろ昆布のだし、おばんざい3種・5種盛り、ハーフサイズ、とうもろこしの天ぷら、フルーツトマトの揚げ物、いちじくの天ぷら、生麩田楽、卯の花、おから、豚のしゃぶユッケ、ポテサラ、アジフライ、さばの揚げ物、メンチカツ、里芋の唐揚げ、なすの肉詰め、万願寺とうがらしのサワー、日本酒、子供用のおにぎり、三条木屋町に2号店、2階への急な階段、刺身の生臭さ (2026年5月)、少し塩辛い (2026年9月)、やや高め (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Sunken-kotatsu seating; steep stairs; children welcome (rice balls for kids).

kyoto_pontocho_yakitori_torihara.gf_detail: Ask: skewers come with salt water, tare and koji soy sauce — the salt-water dip may suit; atsuage and stewed offal not checked (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_yakitori_torihara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori counter; grilled vegetables are on the menu but not described as vegan (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_yakitori_torihara.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday, plus every other Monday or Wednesday; closing time varies some days. Reservations recommended — few walk-in seats (2022; 2025–2026). Appetizer ¥500 a person, included in courses — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し500円/人（コースご利用の場合は料金に含まれてます）」. 14 seats: 10 at the counter, 4 at a table. Non-smoking; wheelchair access. Smartphone/QR ordering (2023; February and September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay and others). West side of Pontocho about 30 m south of the Kaburenjo.
kyoto_pontocho_yakitori_torihara.notes: [Yakitori · Pontocho by the Kaburenjo, skewers kept hot on your own grill] A small, bright counter in Pontocho where skewers come to a mini charcoal grill in front of you, with salt-water, tare and koji-soy dips, obanzai starters and good sake. Book ahead. Some 2026 regulars found the skewers smaller and pricier than before. ¥500 appetizer. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 praise juicy chicken, the homemade salt, tare and koji soy sauce, jazz and a calm room; two staff work the room in February 2026, while an April 2026 regular saw "the owner was busy managing everything alone" during cherry-blossom season. Criticism: ordering drinks by phone even at the counter (April 2023), skewers "on the smaller side and a bit dry" with Pontocho prices (March 2026), and smaller, changed yakitori and a more tourist-oriented menu (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: November 2022: "The dishes are first grilled in the kitchen but instead of being served on a plate, they are placed on a grill in front of you, allowing you to enjoy them hot and fresh."
September 2026: "The charcoal grill was indeed hot, but if you eat too slowly, the food might overcook."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町 焼鳥 鶏原、焼き鳥・居酒屋、中京区先斗町通三条下ル材木町182-2、先斗町歌舞練場の約30m南の西側、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、月・水〜日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、火曜休み、隔週で月曜か水曜も休み、予約可、原文で「お通し500円/人（コースご利用の場合は料金に含まれてます）」、14席 (カウンター10、テーブル4)、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、飲み放題付きコース、法人会員。口コミ (2022年4月〜2026年9月、英語): 目の前の小さな炭火の焼き台に串を置く、塩水・たれ・麹醤油の3種、むね、もも、せせり、ねぎま、つくね (月見)、野菜や魚介の焼き物、トマト、季節のおばんざいのお通し、だし巻き、厚揚げ、もつ煮、日本酒、スマホで注文、予約がおすすめ、串が小さく少し乾いていた (2026年3月)、以前より小さく味も変わった (2026年4月)。

kyoto_suigyoza_shantan_pontocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-skin boiled dumplings and ramen to finish (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_suigyoza_shantan_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and shrimp dumplings, pork and oyster shabu-shabu (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_suigyoza_shantan_pontocho.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–24:00; irregular closures posted on Instagram — it may close on nights without bookings, so reserve. Tell the shop in advance if bringing children; one drink per person. Seat charge ¥550 including the appetizer — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お席料（お通し代含む）550円」. 18 seats: about 6 at the counter and tables (one room for 8). Non-smoking. Cards (overseas-issued cards may not work) and PayPay; no e-money. 2nd floor up steep stairs, Pontocho below Sanjo. Opened 16 November 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_suigyoza_shantan_pontocho.notes: [Boiled dumplings · Pontocho, wanko-soba-style suigyoza] A cosy second-floor bar run single-handed by its owner, where boiled dumplings come two at a time to a pot on your table — keep going, and a drink is free after 20 — with pork or oyster shabu-shabu, tomato oden and ramen to finish. ¥550 seat charge. Book ahead; irregular closures.

chef_bio.background: Opened 16 November 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 say it "was run by one woman" (May 2022) — "the female owner manages everything on her own" (April 2025) — with dumplings said to be based on home cooking (May 2022). They praise her warmth and timing; one August 2025 reviewer notes she "placed the hot dumplings on a plate at a distance and added more at just the right moment". Drinks such as beer are "slightly higher" in price (August 2025).

anecdotes.text: May 2022: "The dining style is self-serve hot water at the table, where you count with tokens and every 10 tokens turn into a marble… I even heard of someone who ate as many as 80!"
March 2026: "Despite running the place alone, the attention to detail and care provided were truly impressive."
